meta.title: VIETNAM TRIP PLAN |MALAYALAM|HANOI | PHU QOC | HO CHI MINH | DA NANG | BUDGET |ITINERARY| FOOD |STAY
meta.description:
Dreaming of exploring Vietnam? 🇻🇳 From the bustling streets of Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City to the breathtaking landscapes of Ha Long Bay, Da Nang, and Ninh Binh, this Malayalam travel guide is your complete roadmap to an unforgettable Vietnam trip. ✨

In this video, we share our complete Vietnam trip experience — how to reach, visa process, where to stay, what to eat, places to explore, how much budget you need, and the perfect itinerary to plan your journey.

📍 In this Vietnam Travel Guide:
00:00 – Kerala to Vietnam Trip Overview
00:21 – Welcome & Introduction
00:41 – Highlights & Regions of Vietnam
01:20 – Top 4 Major Regions 
02:25 – Other Popular Places to Visit 
02:45 – Best Time to Visit & Seasonal Guide 
03:17 – How to Apply for E-Visa & Phu Quoc Visa Exemption Rules
04:37 – Currency Exchange (INR to VND) & Forex/ATM Cards
05:03 – SIM Card Options, Power Adapters & Travel Insurance
05:46 – Day 1: Hanoi Arrival, Old Quarter Exploration, French Quarter & Trying Egg Coffee
06:42 – Day 2: Sapa Arrival, Local Mountain Life Experience, Trekking & Fansipan Peak Tour
07:26 – Day 3: Ninh Binh Boat Tour & Halong Bay Cruise Experience
08:40 – Day 4: Central Vietnam Arrival, Da Nang Beaches & Dragon Bridge
10:28 – Day 5: Ba Na Hills Day Trip, Golden Bridge & Cable Car
11:52 – Day 6: Hoi An Ancient Town Walking Tour, Lanterns & Tailor Shops
12:57 – Day 7: Ho Chi Minh City Arrival, War Remnants Museum & Street Life
13:49 – Day 8: Cu Chi Tunnels Tour & Mekong Delta Boat Ride
14:34 – Day 9: Phu Quoc Island Arrival, Cable Car & Sunset Beach
14:52 – Day 10: Phu Quoc Island Hopping, Snorkeling & Water Activities
16:01 – How to Reach Vietnam from Kerala 
17:21 – Internal Transportation Options 
17:41 – Must-Try Vietnamese Foods 
18:20 – Shopping Guide & Local Souvenirs 
19:02 – Essential Travel & Packing Tips
19:58 – Total Trip Cost & Detailed Budget Breakdown
20:30 – Travel Agency & Contact Info

Whether you're planning a family vacation, couple trip, solo adventure, or friends' getaway, this guide will help you plan your Vietnam trip easily and within budget. 🌏
